title: What Is a Fractional Growth Partner? | Vestis Solutions
description: A fractional growth partner gives owner-led businesses COO, CMO and CTO-type help from one person, for less than one full-time hire. Here's how it works.
h1: What a fractional growth partner does for an owner-led business
intro: You need help with marketing, operations and your tech, all at once. Hiring three executives isn't realistic. Hiring three separate vendors means three invoices, three opinions and you stuck in the middle. A fractional growth partner is one person who looks at all of it and helps you fix what matters most first.
definition: A fractional growth partner is one experienced, part-time partner who combines COO, CMO and CTO-type help for an owner-led business: getting found, turning leads into jobs, connecting systems, and advising the owner on key decisions. It costs less than one full-time hire.

sections.h2: Why one fractional growth partner instead of three roles
paras: In a small business, the problems are connected. More leads don't help if follow-up is broken. A new CRM doesn't help if nobody owns the process. A separate marketing agency, operations consultant and IT person each see one piece, and you're left to connect them.
A fractional growth partner sees the whole business, finds the real bottleneck, and fixes that first. Then we turn up the volume.
Each month, the partnership covers four areas.
bullets: Getting found (CMO-type): SEO and AEO for Google, Google Maps, ChatGPT and Gemini, plus a website built or rebuilt to be found
Sales process (COO-type): a review of how leads are handled from first contact to signed job, then fixes with your team
Systems (CTO-type): connecting the tools you already use, such as your CRM, scheduling, estimating, phones, forms and accounting
Executive advice (CEO-level): four 30-minute owner sessions on the one or two decisions that matter most, from hiring to the numbers you watch

paras: Here's a plain comparison. A full-time COO, CMO or CTO is a full executive salary for one area. Separate agencies and consultants each cover one area, often on separate contracts, and nobody owns the whole picture. A fractional growth partner covers all four areas through one person, starting at $3,000 a month.

The trade-off is hours. You get up to 12 delivery hours a month plus owner sessions, not a full-time employee. For most owner-led businesses, focused hours on the right problem beat a full-time hire working on the wrong one. Paid ads are optional and extra, and you pay the ad budget directly.

Day one is discovery: how the business runs and where it's stuck. Within the first week, we agree on the top priority. SEO and AEO work gets going early, the sales process review is done by around day 60, and every 30 days we review what changed. At day 90, we set the next priority and continue month to month.

I'm Alex Kiforishin, based in Charlotte, NC. I spent over a decade in banking and finance working with business owners, then co-founded a company and lived it myself. I work with trade and home-service businesses locally and across the US.

faq.q: What is a fractional growth partner?
faq.a: A fractional growth partner is one part-time partner who combines COO, CMO and CTO-type help for an owner-led business. That covers getting found online, fixing the sales process, connecting your systems and advising you on big decisions. It costs less than a single full-time executive.

faq.q: How is a fractional growth partner different from a fractional COO or CMO?
faq.a: A fractional COO or CMO covers one area, while a fractional growth partner covers several through one person. In a small business, marketing, sales, operations and systems affect each other. One partner can find the real bottleneck instead of fixing one area while another holds you back.

faq.q: How much does a fractional growth partner cost?
faq.a: My partnerships start at $3,000 a month, billed monthly. That includes a website build or rebuild, ongoing SEO and AEO, a sales process review, four owner sessions and up to 12 delivery hours. Paid ad budgets are separate and paid by you directly.

faq.q: What kind of businesses use a fractional growth partner?
faq.a: Owner-led businesses that are growing but stretched thin get the most from it. My core clients are trade and home-service companies such as roofing, HVAC, plumbing and contractors. The common thread is an owner who is still the bottleneck and wants the business to run without them.

The first commitment is 90 days, then it continues month to month. Ninety days is long enough to fix something real and measure it. After that, you stay because it's working, and scope is confirmed together after the fit call.

Book a free 30-minute fit call at cal.com/choosevestis/fit-call. Tell me the biggest thing slowing you down, and I'll come with a first read on where the fix is. By the end of the call, you'll know whether working together makes sense.
